description: Panther Tyres Limited manufactures and sells tyres and tubes for vehicles, along with lubricants and spare parts, at a purpose-built factory on a 30-acre site at 29.5 km on the Sheikhupura Road. Founded in 1983 as Mian Tyre and Rubber Company, it became a public limited company in 2003, took the Panther Tyres name in 2011 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in February 2021; in 2019 it produced Pakistan's first locally made 350 kg OTR tyre.
headOffice: Panther House, 97-B, Aziz Avenue, Jail Road, Lahore, Pakistan
